original_question:
Write a Verilog module named `full_adder` that implements a standard single-bit combinational full adder circuit. The module should have the following interface:
Inputs: `A`, `B`, `Ci` (carry-in)
Outputs: `S` (sum), `Co` (carry-out)
Your implementation should correctly compute the sum and carry-out based on the inputs using basic logic gates.
